EX series

EX Trainer Kit 2 Plusle

Released March 1, 2006 · 12 cards

EX Trainer Kit 2 Plusle is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on March 1, 2006. It has 12 cards. It includes 7 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

10 illustrators worked on EX Trainer Kit 2 Plusle. Most cards: Atsuko Nishida (1), Hiroki Fuchino (1), Hisao Nakamura (1), Kagemaru Himeno (1), Kai Ishikawa (1), Katsura Tabata (1), Keiji Kinebuchi (1), Ken Sugimori (1).
